units: <cite ref="Berakhot 17a:11">Ber. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>תכלית ח׳ וכ׳</he> the perfection of wisdom is repentance and good deeds.
<cite ref="Berakhot 33a:17">Ib. 33ᵃ</cite> <he>ברכת ח׳</he> the benediction of wisdom (the fourth of the Prayer of Benedictions).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 17:5">Gen. R. s. 17</cite> <he>חָכְמָתוֹ מרובה וכ׳</he> his (Adam’s) wisdom is greater than yours.
R. Hash. 29ᵇ שהיא ח׳ ואינה מלאכה it is an art and not a labor; a. v. fr.—לשון ח׳ enigmatical speech.
